methods.description: Substitute initial value, decimal rate and elapsed periods to find or write value left.
Subtract salvage value from initial value to obtain the total loss.
Identify the starting value, periods and rate from the multiplier below one.
Divide by the decay factor, or solve initial value minus salvage value for a stated total loss.
Divide final by initial value and take the appropriate root to recover 1-r.
Try whole periods and check the predecessor at the required salvage/loss threshold.
Read initial and one-year values from the axes; apply the depreciation formula beyond supplied years.
Apply successive period multipliers to each current value when a stated rate changes.
Recover the multiplier from consecutive values then project using the same rate.
Calculate single-year losses from values at the starts of the relevant years.
Cancel a positive initial value and test whole years against the required remaining fraction.
